messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['We have carried out a system upgrade today by 12\xa0Pm to free server space for new accounts and informed all account users to reconnect for first-time access as old inactive accounts will automatically be deleted from the server within 24 hours.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'A DGTFX virus has been detected in your folders.', 'Call the Support Center-HELP for information about any OWA Gateway service', 'Every time you log on to our online service, we check to ensure that your current browser and computer settings will give the required level of performance and security.', 'New security updates need to be performed on our servers, due to the rate of phishing.', "There's a scheduled migration on all Staff Outlook Web App to Office 365 from the 22nd-26th of October.", 'Take note of this important update that our new web mail has been improved with a new message system from OWA/outlook which also include faster usage on email, shared calendar, web-documents and the new 2017 anti-spam version.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"We upgrade servers, software, and email services; strengthen security against viruses and phishing; and improve access, performance, and collaboration tools."}
